common_intent_requirements.text: 画面左侧的一盏台灯照着桌上的小立方体
common_intent_requirements.normal_source_quote: 画面左侧的一盏台灯照着桌上的小立方体
common_intent_requirements.h3_refined_evidence: a desk lamp on screen-left, and a small opaque cube on the table. The lamp head is above the table and directs its light toward the cube.

common_intent_requirements.text: 让它在右侧桌面投下阴影
common_intent_requirements.normal_source_quote: 让它在右侧桌面投下阴影
common_intent_requirements.h3_refined_evidence: Leave enough clear tabletop on screen-right to show the cube casting a readable shadow away from the lamp.
The lamp and camera remain stationary.

common_intent_requirements.text: 慢慢把立方体向前推一点
common_intent_requirements.normal_source_quote: 慢慢把立方体向前推一点
common_intent_requirements.h3_refined_evidence: A hand slowly pushes the cube a short distance forward along the tabletop, toward its front edge, without lifting it.

physics_checks.criterion: 主阴影方向与给定光源和遮挡物位置相容。
physics_checks.observable_evidence: 台灯、立方体及背光侧桌面阴影可同时比较。
fail_examples: 只有左侧光源时清晰主阴影稳定朝向光源
阴影穿离物体且与移动完全无关
not_required: 不要求精确影长或锐利硬边
允许半影和弱环境光填充

physics_checks.criterion: 物体移动时阴影具有连续对应变化。
physics_checks.observable_evidence: 立方体位移过程中主阴影位置或轮廓同步连续变化。
fail_examples: 物体明显移动而主阴影钉在原位置
阴影无原因复制或突然翻到光源侧
not_required: 不要求阴影与物体等尺寸或同速度

evaluation_boundary: Assess only supplied requirements. Professional additions are not hidden requirements for ordinary input.
